description: A painted dusk scene on a murky, rippled river harbour. A grey patrol launch with a railed deck carries about seven people in dark clothing, several with binoculars held to their eyes. Cargo barges, tugs, cranes and smokestacks with smoke fill the background under a pale sun. Beneath the water in the lower foreground, a pale long-beaked river dolphin glides as a faint shadow. No text, frame or border is visible.
